ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with an estimated 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white contiguous zones occupy the medial sections of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation is mapped as a continuous band along the trailing edge and as irregular mottling and focal clusters dispersed throughout the white regions, with higher density in the distal half of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 35 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the lobe hinge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge. Pixel-amplitude variations are most pronounced at the distal tips, showing jagged peaks and deep valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, transitioning to slightly tapered distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple discrete, low-intensity circular pixel clusters (black spots) distributed across the white medial fields; highest concentration observed on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, low-intensity linear pixel streaks (rake marks) are visible on the distal-medial portion of the right lobe, oriented roughly perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular jaggedness and potential material loss at the extreme left distal tip; localized linear scarring (rake marks) on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetric pigmentation density where the right lobe contains a higher frequency of small-scale black mottling compared to the more solid white regions of the left lobe.
